The 1957 Soviet Cup was a football tournament that took place in the Soviet Union. This was the 20th edition of the Soviet Cup, a nationwide football competition.

The competition started on 8 June 1957 and concluded on 6 November 1957. The tournament involved 44 teams from across the nation, with the teams competing in a knockout format. It started from the first round, then moved through successive phases like the Last 32, Last 16, quarterfinals, semifinals, and finally the final. 

The final match of the competition was held at Central Lenin Stadium in Moscow, which is now known as the Luzhniki Stadium. The final match was contested by Spartak Yerevan and Shakhtyor Stalino (now known as Shakhtar Donetsk).

Spartak Yerevan, a team from Armenian SSR, won the 1957 Soviet Cup. This was the first and only time that they won the Soviet Cup. They defeated Shakhtyor Stalino 2-1 in the final.

Nikolai Parshin from Spartak Moscow was the top scorer of the tournament, scoring seven goals in total. 

By winning the 1957 Soviet Cup, Spartak Yerevan automatically qualified for the 1958 Soviet Top League, the top-tier football league in the Soviet Union.
